name: Stage 32:2: Kolmårdens djurpark to Lövsjöns sydspets, etapp 32
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 32:2, Kolmårdens djurpark to Lövsjöns sydspets, etapp 32.
utilities: Kolmårdens djurpark gives strong bus/parking access to this blue-marked connector, but zoo/park services are seasonal, ticketed or customer-dependent. Treat toilets, food and water there as available only when open and accessible.

This is easy gravel-road access on Fjällmossevägen/Dammkärrsvägen rather than a standalone forest-trail stage. OSM labels the relation orange, but the official Sörmlandsleden page says the connector is blue-marked; user reports in 2019, 2020 and 2025 agree it is simple gravel-road access.
No toilet, shelter, tap, campsite, shop, power or waste facility was verified on connector 32:2 itself. Nearby useful facilities are on adjacent stage 32, around Lövsjön, or at Kolmården.
waterSources: No verified drinking-water source on the 1.5 km connector. Use Kolmården services only when open/accessed, or carry water.
Nearby water sources are not on 32:2: Lövsjön is surface water only, Ålkärrsdrogen is on stage 33 about 3 km from Lövsjön, and Lugnet spring is far away on stage 32. Treat/filter natural water.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official connector is 1.5 km from Kolmårdens djurpark to Lövsjöns sydspets, blue-marked and mostly/effectively gravel-road walking on Fjällmossevägen/Dammkärrsvägen. Naturkartan/OSM geometry measures closer to about 1.84 km and AllTrails about 1.8 km; use official 1.5 km as canonical.

Official Sörmlandsleden page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Nearby Lövsjöstigen in Fjällmossen is temporarily closed in 2026 because of fallen trees and poor boardwalks; this is a nearby loop warning, not a confirmed 32:2 closure.

Fjällmossen/Lövsjön reserve context near the north end: no tenting/camping or caravans, dogs leashed, fires only at designated places, no damaging trees/dead wood, and motor vehicles/parking only where permitted.

Kolmården parking is paid and operationally separate from trail access: main parking was listed as 149 SEK/day or 40 SEK/started hour, night parking can be expensive, and Apans parking may be gated after zoo closing. Vildmarkshotellet parking/entrance is for hotel/Safari Camp guests with permit.

Use Östgötatrafiken line 420 as the primary current bus context for Kolmårdens Djurpark; line 902 is limited school-day rural traffic. Older blog references to bus 433 should be treated as stale unless a live planner shows it.
Trips that combine Kolmården and Stavsjö may cross Östgötatrafiken/Sörmlandstrafiken boundaries; use Resrobot or both operators' planners and do not assume one ticket covers everything.
Topology: keep 32:2 as a separate access spur. The shared route junction is OSM/Naturkartan node context near 58.679192, 16.477323; do not continue the main Sörmlandsleden south-west to Kolmården.

facilities.name: Kolmården 32:2 stage board
facilities.description: Official start by Kolmårdens djurpark parking/stage board. Blue-marked connector begins here and follows Fjällmossevägen toward Lövsjön; Naturkartan's geometry start is offset slightly west around 58.667247, 16.462047.

facilities.name: Kolmårdens Djurpark bus stop
facilities.description: Closest bus access near the connector start. Use Östgötatrafiken line 420 as primary current access; line 902 is limited school-day rural traffic. Verify live departures and cross-operator tickets.

facilities.name: Gruvstugan backup bus stop
facilities.description: Backup bus-stop context west of the official trailhead, also on line 420. Useful if live routing suggests it, but it is not the named official access point.

facilities.name: Kolmården station transfer context
facilities.description: Kolmården station is not walk-close to 32:2; use bus transfer or live planner. Kolmården and Östgötatrafiken describe bus links from station/Norrköping to the zoo entrance.

facilities.name: Kolmården main parking
facilities.description: Large paid zoo parking near the connector start. Current checks found 149 SEK/day or 40 SEK/started hour, APCOA-listed night parking at 400 SEK 21:00-05:00, 24 EV charging points, and ANPR/payment rules; verify current terms.

facilities.name: Apans parking gate caveat
facilities.description: Kolmården FAQ says Apans parking closes 60 minutes after park closing. Do not rely on zoo parking for late-return or overnight trail logistics without checking current rules.

facilities.name: Kolmården visitor services
facilities.description: Toilets, kiosk/shop/food, lockers, guest services and similar visitor facilities are nearby but depend on park opening, ticket/access or customer status. Do not treat as guaranteed public trail facilities.

facilities.name: Kolmården entrance toilets
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet near the Kolmården visitor/entrance area. Access may depend on park/entrance operations, so do not treat as a reliable early/late trail toilet.

facilities.name: Tropicarium paid-service context
facilities.description: Nearby Tropicarium/zoo-area service context with separate admission/opening rules. Useful landmark, not a guaranteed free trail toilet or food stop.

facilities.name: Kolmården EV charging
facilities.description: EV chargers in the zoo parking area. Parking/payment rules likely apply; verify current operator terms.

facilities.name: Vildmarkshotellet services context
facilities.description: Hotel/restaurant/lodging context near Kolmården, about 1-1.2 km from the connector start. Verify access, booking and opening; hotel parking is not general trail parking.

facilities.name: Fjällmossevägen / Dammkärrsvägen connector
facilities.description: Short easy blue-marked gravel-road connector; useful access rather than a standalone hiking objective. No facilities documented along the road.

facilities.name: Lövsjöns sydspets junction
facilities.description: Shared OSM/Naturkartan route junction with stages 32, 32:2 and 33. Official Stage 33 start/parking coordinate is about 100-120 m away; use this for topology and local signs for exact parking.

facilities.name: Lövsjön south-end fire/rest point
facilities.description: Mapped picnic/fireplace near the north end of the connector. Use only where reserve rules and current fire-risk/fire-ban status allow.

facilities.name: Lövsjön south-end bathing/rest
facilities.description: Lövsjön south/southeast shore rest and bathing context. Surface water only, not a verified drinking-water refill.

facilities.name: Lövsjön shelter/toilet nearby
facilities.description: Adjacent stage-32 shelter/toilet about 0.8-1.5 km north of the connector junction, useful if continuing on stage 32. Not on 32:2 itself.

facilities.name: Lövsjön dry toilet nearby
facilities.description: Dry toilet by the adjacent stage-32 Lövsjön shelter cluster. Not on connector 32:2 itself.

facilities.name: Fjällmossen/Lövsjön reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve context near Lövsjön: no tenting/camping/caravans, dogs leashed, fires only at designated places, do not damage living/dead trees, and park/drive only where allowed. Same-day fire bans override fireplaces.

facilities.name: Lövsjöstigen nearby-loop closure
facilities.description: Nearby Fjällmossen loop warning: Länsstyrelsen says Lövsjöstigen is closed during 2026 due to fallen trees and poor boardwalk condition. This is not confirmed as a 32:2 closure.
